questions.question_text: According to the chapter, how can research skills help with college and career readiness?

options.text: By helping you avoid all applications and interviews
By providing solid facts for essays and showing initiative in interviews
By focusing only on hobbies unrelated to your goals
By spending large amounts like ₹50,000 (approx. $600) on resources

correct_answer.text: By providing solid facts for essays and showing initiative in interviews

questions.question_text: What is one way the chapter suggests using research to solve everyday problems?

options.text: Ignoring small issues and hoping they resolve themselves
Searching for product reviews before buying items like a ₹3,000 (approx. $36) phone case
Relying solely on friends’ opinions without checking facts
Spending ₹1,000 (approx. $12) on professional help for every issue

correct_answer.text: Searching for product reviews before buying items like a ₹3,000 (approx. $36) phone case

questions.question_text: What does the chapter recommend for staying updated with credible news and information?

options.text: Believing every WhatsApp forward without verification
Sticking to trusted sources like BBC India and fact-checking viral claims
Only reading random blogs with sensational headlines
Avoiding news altogether to save time and ₹100 (approx. $1.20) data

correct_answer.text: Sticking to trusted sources like BBC India and fact-checking viral claims

questions.question_text: How does the chapter describe lifelong learning through research?

options.text: As something that stops after high school ends
As a way to fuel curiosity and learn new skills or hobbies for free or low cost like ₹200 (approx. $2.40)
As a process that requires expensive courses worth ₹5,000 (approx. $60)
As unimportant compared to earning money immediately

correct_answer.text: As a way to fuel curiosity and learn new skills or hobbies for free or low cost like ₹200 (approx. $2.40)
